steps.en: State Courts send daily mention detail files
steps.id: State Courts mengirim file harian detail mention
steps.why_en: No State Courts file channel is set up.
steps.why_id: Belum ada jalur file State Courts.

steps.why_en: No job exists to fetch court files.
steps.why_id: Belum ada job untuk mengambil file court.

steps.en: OCMS processes the file content into mention data
steps.id: OCMS memproses isi file menjadi data mention
steps.why_en: No parser or storage for mention data exists.
steps.why_id: Belum ada pembaca file atau penyimpanan data mention.
Belum ada yang menyimpan file court.

steps.en: The officer downloads the files from OCMS
steps.why_en: Only a generic download exists; no court file or page uses it.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada unduhan umum; belum ada file atau halaman court yang memakainya.
